programme.title: Save this Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife 第1季
programme.desc: Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. programme.title: Beauty and the Reef 第1季
programme.desc:
This is a crucial documentary told by those who have lived and breathed
every facet of this reef and been the advocates long before people understood
the changes..
The vision of 10,000 dives through the producer half of these on the Great
Barrier reef to provide the avenue of understanding of change.
The knowledge of one of the worlds leading marine biologist who has spent
his life in the water and advised governments on upcoming changes is world
class..
Lin Sutherland has published hundreds of article on the marine environment,
has been a photographer, videographer and passionate advocate who has
always understood the journey of the Great barrier reef, few people have the
insight into this ecosystem like her.
This will be a film of a lifetime.

programme.title: Save this Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Save this Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Beauty and the Reef 第1季
programme.desc:
This is a crucial documentary told by those who have lived and breathed
every facet of this reef and been the advocates long before people understood
the changes..
The vision of 10,000 dives through the producer half of these on the Great
Barrier reef to provide the avenue of understanding of change.
The knowledge of one of the worlds leading marine biologist who has spent
his life in the water and advised governments on upcoming changes is world
class..
Lin Sutherland has published hundreds of article on the marine environment,
has been a photographer, videographer and passionate advocate who has
always understood the journey of the Great barrier reef, few people have the
insight into this ecosystem like her.
This will be a film of a lifetime.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons 第6季
programme.desc: We're putting the action-packed film Nobody to the test. Booby Traps, Claymores and Riot shields make for an interesting day at the range.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife 第1季
programme.desc: Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals. The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第3季
programme.desc: Bear and Super Bowl champion Marshawn Lynch tackle a rugged mountain range that has sharp cliffs and dark chasms; the pair comes face to face with the French Foreign Legion and pursues a wild hog for dinner.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.sub-title: Birds Of A Feather / Duck and Pheasant
programme.desc: Mario must face his fear as he harvests crayfish and abolone during the mating season of the great white sharks. He then heads up into chamois territory in mountain tops of Fiordland. This world heritage area is where the mountains meet the sea, it’s very remote and rugged and the perfect setting for a New Zealand inspired surf and turf dish.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness 第2季
programme.sub-title: Sea Turtle Snorkel, Night Ghost Crab Hunt & Giant Gumboot Chiton
programme.desc: Coyote swims with sea turtles in Hawaii and catches a giant gumboot chiton in the Salish Sea.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Anthony Joshua 第1季
programme.desc: Adventurer Bear Grylls teaches the unified world heavyweight champion some alternative survival skills.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第4季
programme.desc: Bear takes one of the best athletes of all time, Roger Federer, on a daring adventure through the Swiss Alps as they attempt to navigate the tough terrain. They descend a frozen waterfall and use tennis rackets as snowshoes.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第4季第2集 -Joseph Gordon-Levitt
programme.desc: Bear and Joseph Gordon-Levitt navigate Kenya's unyielding terrain; Joseph and Bear navigate a perilous rappel, milk a camel for hydration, ascend a massive rock dome and battle a crocodile for dinner; Joseph talks about his family and rise to fame.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the South American country of Bolivia, Catfish and Rooftop put their bravery to the test. This duo goes 0 for 2 in the ring testing out their fight skills participating in traditional Tinku fighting and getting smacked down by Bolivia’s Fighting Cholitas. They also face a sketchy ride up death rode just to mountain bike down an equally dangerous path. Catfish has yet to keep a meal down as our bikers try llama brains and Rooftop nearly gets run over as a dancing zebra in the streets. The two top their Bolivian trip off with a trip to the mines on the hunt for silver. With some of the most dangerous activities yet, will Rooftop and Catfish be able to leave Bolivia with just a few bumps and bruises from along the way.

香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 動物讀心術》. 大熊貓一天24小時的生活，是否只是吃飽睡，睡飽再吃？海洋公園的資訊科技專家和研究人員決定一探究竟！他們透過24小時攝影鏡頭捕捉大熊貓的一舉一動，然後用 AI 解碼牠們的動作，了解牠們喜歡在哪個區域停留、哪一款玩具最吸引牠們，以及甚麼時間最活躍。負責設計程式的資訊科技專家石音洲，更被同事對動物的熱誠所感染，希望 AI 能幫到更多有心的護理員，下一步更計劃將這項技術應用在海豚的研究上。. 另一邊廂，Eugene 與 Oscar 兩姊弟視小動物為家人。他們曾經因為未能及早察覺愛犬的病痛而抱憾，決定化遺憾為動力，研發出貓狗專用的 AI 健康監測平台——教大家如何從日常的「便便」中看出端倪，及早找出小動物的健康警號！. 科技未必能讓我們真的變成「動物傳心師」，但至少讓我們更貼近牠們的世界、更懂得愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第四集：林臻東回到車隊解釋
programme.desc: 林臻東出去後發現自己的時間消失了一天，他回到車隊趕緊給葉功解釋昨天是林臻東本人而不是自己，大家也沒明白是甚麼情況。林臻東表示，張馳會因為邀請賽而摔斷腿，但是大家都不願意相信林臻東的說話.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 石磊在唐小龍的威脅下，不得已賣了祖宅還錢。安欣帶著專案小組去探望石磊，在勸說下，石磊和專案小組合作。專案組向徐忠匯報，安欣認為隊伍有人在給唐小龍通風報信。安欣設局帶張彪及刑警隊成員突擊唐小龍的賣淫窩點，稱其今天會來收賬，張彪果不其然給唐小龍通風報信.

programme.title: 無所畏懼之永不放棄
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：羅英子支持陳碩決定
programme.desc: 英子去找許卓協商又找方麗虹幫忙陳碩的事皆遭拒，於是決定邀請陳碩加入瑛華但陳碩拒絕了。方麗虹擔心英子和邱華會因此事在萬紇案上發難，立即找來許卓通報情況。許卓把事情告知鼎薪劉總並取得劉總同意暫不報警，但英子認為應該報警，更向陳碩表示支持他和詺山對抗到底.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 我所看見的風暴
programme.desc: 風暴正變得越來越強烈。但反擊戰已經在雲層之上展開。如今，尖端技術正協助我們以前所未見的方式追蹤最危險的天氣狀況，就閃電、龍捲風和颶風發出警告，保障人們的安全。全球天氣正由令人贊歎的飛行實驗室監察，例如英國每日攜帶四噸科學儀器起飛的飛機。由瑞士製造、飛行高度刷新紀錄的高空無人機亦在觀測天氣。此外，還有尖端的氣象衛星從太空監測，例如美國的革命性衛星，正偵測和追蹤大西洋的颶風，減少這些風暴登陸加勒比海和佛羅里達州等位置所造成的破壞。歐洲亦有自己的秘密武器，就是有史以來最先進的氣象衛星。它們監測危險天氣，及早發現山火，協助救急人員拯救生命。有了衛星、無人機和氣象飛機的保護，我們預測天氣的能力比以往更強。但人類亦嘗試控制天氣，包括利用人工降雨去製造雨水。這是個具爭議性的議題，但世界各地都在進行。氣候變化正令全球天氣變得更具殺傷力。地球的氣象監測武器庫，在保障人類安全的戰爭中扮演不可或缺的角色.

programme.desc: 阿盧在夢中領悟到，即使身處最奇異的處境，依然能夠尋獲快樂.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 婦產科醫生蘇心因家事要急回國
programme.desc: 婦產科醫生蘇心八歲的女兒摔傷了腿，奶奶認為蘇心沒有盡到母親的責任還怪她沒帶好孩子，一氣之下回了老家，蘇心的女兒無人照看，急得蘇心要回國。柳曉弦的師兄李默，想請柳曉弦去香港上班，繼續她做理想的民生節目，原來李默一直以來對柳曉弦都有意思，哪怕她已婚.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 根據環保署的研究，海洋垃圾與人類活動息息相關，偏遠海灣因水流及地理因素，往往成為垃圾積聚的黑點，發泡膠碎、漁網和膠樽隨處可見。環保署推出「組織海岸清潔活動八部曲」，讓市民可以自行組織清潔活動，並獲得垃圾袋、棉手套等物資支援.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Gordon Ramsay 瘋味之旅 3
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay在波多黎各探索，從碧海到內陸山區，了解颱風瑪莉亞的破壞和居民的復修過程。大廚Jose Enrique帶他用魚槍捕魚、攀爬瀑布捕鮮蝦，並乘直升機前往有機咖啡莊園。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年1月14日 星期二晚，10時30分 Gordon Ramsay explores the enchanted island of Puerto Rico; from the bright blue sea to the lush mountains of the interior. Along the way he learns about Hurricane Maria’s devastating toll on the island, and how its destruction prompted locals to push for food independence. On this epic adventure, Chef Jose Enrique sends Gordon spearfishing, rappelling down a waterfall for delicious river shrimp, and on a helicopter ride to an organic coffee plantation. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2025.1.14 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：張克寒以金錢誘惑蔣美珍
programme.desc: 審訊室內，張克寒妻子蔡玉琴供述了他是槍殺哨兵案的兇手，一直是獨自作案，不用手機，住在墳地裡。另一邊，張克寒逃至浮城，在一家洗浴中心遇到蔣美珍，並以金錢誘惑她。此時，秦川提議召集專家重新勘查張克寒落腳點，經過反覆的刻畫，他推測張克寒可能會回到昀城作案.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：秦川嚴密佈防追捕張克寒
programme.desc: 2012年8月，昀城松樹坪中安銀行發生槍擊案，秦川迅速判斷出是張克寒所為，並實施佈防追捕。張克寒逃竄過程中又槍殺了鐵警，警方四處張貼通緝令，隨即在大順商場發現他的行蹤。秦川決定以松樹坪附近的墓地作為佈控點，分三線佈防，務求在張克寒再次作案前抓捕他.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 菇長老發現有一個菇BB害羞得不敢和其他菇BB一起玩。他察覺到菇BB為什麼這麼害羞——他很敬佩奀菇菇。菇長老找來奀菇菇來提升菇BB的自信.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 加盟上海申花兩年以來，一仔憑着穩定而出色的表現穩坐正選，成為球隊左路不可或缺的一員。今集將帶大家走進他在上海的日常訓練，了解他如何一步一步適應內地球壇，在高強度競爭中站穩陣腳。鏡頭亦會帶觀眾近距離感受上海申花作為中超前列球隊的比賽氣氛，欣賞一場真正高水平的中超對決。最後，還會聽到申花靈魂人物毛毅軍對一仔的寄語.

programme.desc: 菇長老發現有一個菇BB害羞得不敢和其他菇BB一起玩。他察覺到菇BB為什麼這麼害羞——他很敬佩奀菇菇。菇長老找來奀菇菇來提升菇BB的自信.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2

programme.desc: 中國醫療隊在非洲慶祝春節，並跟在萬里之外的家屬通視像電話。江大喬的女兒江瑤沒出現，江大喬多少有點失落。後來江瑤給江大喬打了電話，江大喬聽出江瑤的聲音不對。馬嘉父親患病，情況不太樂觀。柳曉弦擔心影響馬嘉工作，便將這事瞞下來，由自己照顧家公.

programme.desc: 從庇里牛斯山脈、到大西洋的原始海灘、傳奇的波爾多、科雷茲的鄉郊山谷，無論是生活態度、美酒佳餚抑或農村風景，法國西南部的居民一直忠於自己，這些文化象徵除了是居民的驕傲，每年更吸引數以萬計遊客，前來享受這些珍貴的天然資源和美食。有些人不斷開發這些寶藏，從沒擔心會對環境造成影響；也有些人決定逆流而上，努力建立一個更好的未來，守衛當地的身份象徵.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集: 馬嘉不知道父親病情
programme.desc: 孫爽因父親入獄十分難過，趙一聰向孫爽承諾會永遠陪著她。馬嘉父親不想讓兒子知道他住醫院，反而提醒馬嘉一定要多打電話給柳曉弦。一個有嚴重的腎衰竭的病人，齊丹醫生主張放棄，馬嘉看著病人年青的臉龐不願意放手，與江大喬設法醫治他。那邊廂馬嘉父親也動了大手術.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 我們的好朋友
programme.desc: 作為全球價值逾三千二百億歐元的市場，沒有任何產業能忽視寵物所蘊藏的巨大潛力。如今，竉物已成為家庭不可或缺的一員；我們對待、呵護牠們的方式，與對待孩子無異，甚至有時更加用心。這股潮流令業界人士欣喜不已。從繁殖者到寵物保姆，乃至時尚、美食，甚至殯葬服務，我們在這些毛茸茸的小生命身上，看見了最美好的一面，卻也窺見了不那麼理想的狀況。. In a market worth more than 6.4 billion euros worldwide, no sector can afford to neglect the enormous potential of pets. Today, our four-legged friends are an integral part of the family. We treat them and pamper them as we do our children. Sometimes even better! A trend that delights professionals.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：爆炸案偵查陷入僵局
programme.desc: 秦川認為犯罪嫌疑人可能混在賭徒中，必須從賭場情況入手。警方在案發現場附近找到家中藏有雷管、炸藥的阿金，然而經審訊後，秦川判斷他不像疑犯。秦川嘗試從現場遺留物入手，而曹陽等人則在爆炸殘原件上發現了女性DNA樣本，但這些線索皆無助破案，案件頓時陷入僵局.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：秦川為辦案在山上過年
programme.desc: 郭嘉琦建議通過懸賞發動群眾舉報炸藥來源。一名採石場的司機舉報，稱兩箱炸藥在爆炸案發生前被盜，但卻不知誰偷了炸藥，線索再次中斷。幹警們持續摸排，但毫無進展，秦川決定留在山上過年。年後，秦川下令擴大搜索範圍，終於找到了一個完整的遙控器，大家都歡呼雀躍.

programme.sub-title: 第二十五集: 馬嘉指責柳曉弦
programme.desc: 馬嘉知道父親住院，急得立刻給柳曉弦打電話，一頓劈頭蓋臉的指責，柳曉弦心裡特別委屈。馬嘉知錯，但柳曉弦不肯接他的電話。馬嘉盡力搶治的病人終有起色，齊丹醫生知道醫院有認真的中國醫療隊，決定離開。馬嘉就快要有探親假，柳曉弦拒絕了馬嘉回國，讓他安心工作即可.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: 本集講述兩種菌類作物：一是生長於宜賓長寧縣竹海的竹笙，跟隨烹飪大師李強了解其奧秘所在。另一種是生長於稻城亞丁的松茸，需在八、九月份採摘，當地農戶與孩子們的採摘的故事傳遞了自然與傳承的主題.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: “秋分”象徵豐收。在四川眉山的永豐村，稻田收割季來臨，機器取代了人力，水稻經過處理後進入百姓餐桌。在雲南西雙版納，當地百姓慶祝水稻成熟，採摘作物，製作傣族的“孔雀宴”。豐收寫在稻穗中，藏在枝葉間，刻入食物，印入心中.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Dictation has long been part of Hong Kong primary school life, but new curriculum guidelines urge schools to scale it back. Some have already cancelled Chinese and English dictation, noting that high scores don’t always translate into better writing. Instead, they’re turning to reading, games, and AI-assisted learning to boost literacy. This episode explores how teachers see the changes, how parents respond to the “no dictation” revolution, and whether in an age of smartphones and voice input, students risk forgetting how to write by hand.

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: A Thread of Legacy : Episode One
programme.desc: This is a story spanning more than seventy years. It unfolds between Shanghai and Hong Kong, while remaining closely tied to memories of the family’s hometown of Fenghua in Ningbo. . In the early 1950s, following the liberation of Shanghai, many people brought their skills and capital to Hong Kong in search of new opportunities. Among them was 26-year-old Ascot Chang, who had learnt the craft of Hongbang tailoring in Shanghai. With only ten US dollars, he came to Hong Kong to make a living. There, he settled and founded Ascot Chang, a bespoke menswear shop known for its reliable quality, laying the foundation for a family legacy that would continue through the generations. . In the late 1970s, as Ascot’s health began to fail, he asked his son Tony, who had just completed his university studies in the United States to return and help manage the business. Though Tony had known little about tailoring at the outset, he went on to devote more than four decades to the trade. Guided by his father’s exacting standards and commitment to craftsmanship, he followed closely in his footsteps. . In the 1990s, as reform and opening up brought new opportunities to the mainland, Tony returned to Shanghai, where his father had learnt the craft, to open the family’s first shop there and bring the business to a wider market. At the same time, he carried on his father’s commitment to giving back to his hometown by donating funds for a new school building at a village primary school in Fenghua, Ningbo, his father’s birthplace. . To bring the next generation closer to their roots, Tony arranged for his son Justin to teach English at a rural primary school in Fenghua during the summer. Through everyday contact with the local community, Justin came to appreciate more deeply what it means to return home. In recent years, Tony has also begun restoring the family graves, hoping to preserve a place where the family can gather when they return. In this way, the family’s bond reaches beyond Shanghai and Hong Kong, and continues in Fenghua as a lasting connection.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.sub-title: Live as a beam of light
programme.desc: In a world where light and darkness intertwine, guide dogs stand as loyal guardians for the visually impaired, leading them through life’s thorny paths and weaving a story of loyalty and hope. From the moment he was born, Gabe the Labrador was destined for an extraordinary life. After a rigorous selection process, he was chosen to become a guide dog, embarking on his mission. This documentary traces his journey from puppyhood through training, witnessing how Gabe learns to accompany the visually impaired and becomes a messenger of light in their lives. Along the way, Gabe undergoes training in obedience, navigation, and danger recognition, while also building a deep bond with his trainers—an emotional connection that warms the heart. As Gabe’s training nears completion, he approaches his graduation ceremony, where he will be paired with his visually impaired partner. From strangers to companions, every encounter and every shared moment redefine the meaning of trust and reliance. The stories of the visually impaired are often heartbreaking; many once felt despair after losing their sight. Yet the arrival of a guide dog allows them to embrace life anew. The cold, unfeeling cane is replaced by warm fur. Each steady step, each patient pause, becomes a testament to regained dreams. With the companionship of a guide dog, they walk forward together in light—witnessing the profound bond between human and dog, and the story of hope that shines through.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 不用怕，我會救你出去
programme.desc: 霍岩宗收購了孫磊的公司，孫磊為報復，綁架了徐來。孫磊致電霍岩宗，以徐來生命安全作威脅，要他單獨前去藏參地點。靳時川得知徐來有危險，不顧腿傷前往救人。孫磊說徐來身上裝着炸彈，霍岩宗崩潰。這時靳時川趕到，霍岩宗告訴他徐來的位置，讓靳時川去救她.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 二人關係修復
programme.desc: 靳時川救出徐來，自己也受了傷，向臧秋表示下決心接受手術，治療腿上的腫瘤。手術成功，徐來陪靳做物理治療，表明心跡，就算腿傷不痊癒也會照顧他，二人和好。陸方奇繼續追求臧秋，忍著對花粉過敏，送上她最愛的雛菊，並表示連同她的過去一起去愛，臧秋受打動.

大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 加盟上海申花兩年以來，一仔憑着穩定而出色的表現穩坐正選，成為球隊左路不可或缺的一員。今集將帶大家走進他在上海的日常訓練，了解他如何一步一步適應內地球壇，在高強度競爭中站穩陣腳。鏡頭亦會帶觀眾近距離感受上海申花作為中超前列球隊的比賽氣氛，欣賞一場真正高水平的中超對決。最後，還會聽到申花靈魂人物毛毅軍對一仔的寄語.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂．講樂》Pop Up Show再次到訪葵芳新都會廣場，今次請來兩位唱得之人–黃博及李佳！同樣從選秀節目脫穎而出，兩位歌手展現出不同的歌唱風格。音色成熟渾厚，情感演繹細膩的李佳，今次帶來新歌《Shake it!》，以節奏輕快的爵士樂風味炒熱全場氣氛。音域廣闊、嗓音清澈空靈的黃博，以親自參與作曲的新歌《靈魂上演》，為樂迷帶來溫柔的療癒服務。. 主持. 林泳怡. 歌曲：. 李佳《Shake it!》. 黄博《靈魂上演.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #8 承先啟後 - 卞兆祥教授
programme.desc: 卞兆祥教授扎根香港二十多年，是本地中醫藥發展的一位重要推手。他在浸會大學擔任中醫藥學院臨床部主任超過23年，2012年起更出任協理副校長。2020年獲創新科技署資助成立「中藥創新研發中心」，目標把中醫藥標準化、國際化。近年，他又參與香港中醫醫院的籌建工作，並獲委任成為首任醫院行總監，見証中醫藥發展的新里程。. 卞教授臨床行醫多年，留意到愈來愈多人患消化系統疾病，於是鑽研如何將中醫和西醫加強「合拍」。他形容中西醫結合好比兩個人結婚：「先要磨合、互相了解對方做什麼，然後發揮各自強項，變成更適切的治療。」. 主持：胡志遠教授、梁凱寧. 嘉賓：卞兆祥教授（香港中醫醫院醫院行政總監.

programme.sub-title: 消防及救護教育中心暨博物館
programme.desc: 消防處其中一項重要使命是「教育市民，並提高公眾的消防安全意識」。而消防及救護教育中心暨博物館於2016年隨著消防及救護學院啟用。透過展示過去一些珍貴圖片、制服、裝備和車輛等，讓市民了解消防處150多年的歷史和發展的同時亦能提升個人及社區的消防安全意識.

programme.desc: 北宋年間，開封包拯明鏡高懸，嫉惡如仇，全國天下太平。正因國泰民安，開封府漸無用武之地。來自江湖的游俠展昭(劉德華飾)，為跟隨包大人而放棄以往放浪不羈的生活。可是熱愛自由的他已開始厭倦苦悶的官場生活，他既緬懷過去的雲遊四海，又幻想自己披上黑衣行俠仗義！一次行動中，他遇上了一生中既最可怕但又最重要的朋友——錦毛鼠白玉堂(張柏芝飾).

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 動物讀心術》. 大熊貓一天24小時的生活，是否只是吃飽睡，睡飽再吃？海洋公園的資訊科技專家和研究人員決定一探究竟！他們透過24小時攝影鏡頭捕捉大熊貓的一舉一動，然後用 AI 解碼牠們的動作，了解牠們喜歡在哪個區域停留，以及甚麼時間最活躍。負責設計程式的資訊科技專家石音洲，更被同事對動物的熱誠所感染，希望 AI 能幫到更多有心的護理員，下一步更計劃將這項技術應用在海豚的研究上。. 另一邊廂，Eugene 與 Oscar 兩姊弟視小動物為家人。他們曾經因為未能及早察覺愛犬的病痛而抱憾，決定化遺憾為動力，研發出貓狗專用的 AI 健康監測平台——教大家如何從日常的「便便」中看出端倪，及早找出小動物的健康警號！. 科技未必能讓我們真的變成「動物傳心師」，但至少讓我們更貼近牠們的世界、更懂得愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #8 承先啟後 - 卞兆祥教授
programme.desc: 卞兆祥教授扎根香港二十多年，是本地中醫藥發展的一位重要推手。他在浸會大學擔任中醫藥學院臨床部主任超過23年，2012年起更出任協理副校長。2020年獲創新科技署資助成立「中藥創新研發中心」，目標把中醫藥標準化、國際化。近年，他又參與香港中醫醫院的籌建工作，並獲委任成為首任醫院行總監，見証中醫藥發展的新里程。. 卞教授臨床行醫多年，留意到愈來愈多人患消化系統疾病，於是鑽研如何將中醫和西醫加強「合拍」。他形容中西醫結合好比兩個人結婚：「先要磨合、互相了解對方做什麼，然後發揮各自強項，變成更適切的治療。」. 主持：胡志遠教授、梁凱寧. 嘉賓：卞兆祥教授（香港中醫醫院醫院行政總監.

programme.title: 命懸一生
programme.desc: 吳細妹向警方謊稱遭倪向東情殺騷擾，引起孟朝懷疑，同時警方收到匿名信封鎖定證人孫傳海，得知倪向東行蹤；隨後孟朝與童浩奔赴南洋牙芬村調查徐財增，從老民警老許口中得知倪向東從小是個混混，但村長徐慶棟卻聲稱不認識匯款人，線索一度陷入膠着.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 加盟上海申花兩年以來，一仔憑着穩定而出色的表現穩坐正選，成為球隊左路不可或缺的一員。今集將帶大家走進他在上海的日常訓練，了解他如何一步一步適應內地球壇，在高強度競爭中站穩陣腳。鏡頭亦會帶觀眾近距離感受上海申花作為中超前列球隊的比賽氣氛，欣賞一場真正高水平的中超對決。最後，還會聽到申花靈魂人物毛毅軍對一仔的寄語.

programme.title: 相會雙城
programme.sub-title: A Thread of Legacy : Episode One
programme.desc: This is a story spanning more than seventy years. It unfolds between Shanghai and Hong Kong, while remaining closely tied to memories of the family’s hometown of Fenghua in Ningbo. . In the early 1950s, following the liberation of Shanghai, many people brought their skills and capital to Hong Kong in search of new opportunities. Among them was 26-year-old Ascot Chang, who had learnt the craft of Hongbang tailoring in Shanghai. With only ten US dollars, he came to Hong Kong to make a living. There, he settled and founded Ascot Chang, a bespoke menswear shop known for its reliable quality, laying the foundation for a family legacy that would continue through the generations. . In the late 1970s, as Ascot’s health began to fail, he asked his son Tony, who had just completed his university studies in the United States to return and help manage the business. Though Tony had known little about tailoring at the outset, he went on to devote more than four decades to the trade. Guided by his father’s exacting standards and commitment to craftsmanship, he followed closely in his footsteps. . In the 1990s, as reform and opening up brought new opportunities to the mainland, Tony returned to Shanghai, where his father had learnt the craft, to open the family’s first shop there and bring the business to a wider market. At the same time, he carried on his father’s commitment to giving back to his hometown by donating funds for a new school building at a village primary school in Fenghua, Ningbo, his father’s birthplace. . To bring the next generation closer to their roots, Tony arranged for his son Justin to teach English at a rural primary school in Fenghua during the summer. Through everyday contact with the local community, Justin came to appreciate more deeply what it means to return home. In recent years, Tony has also begun restoring the family graves, hoping to preserve a place where the family can gather when they return. In this way, the family’s bond reaches beyond Shanghai and Hong Kong, and continues in Fenghua as a lasting connection.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.sub-title: Live as a beam of light
programme.desc: In a world where light and darkness intertwine, guide dogs stand as loyal guardians for the visually impaired, leading them through life’s thorny paths and weaving a story of loyalty and hope. From the moment he was born, Gabe the Labrador was destined for an extraordinary life. After a rigorous selection process, he was chosen to become a guide dog, embarking on his mission. This documentary traces his journey from puppyhood through training, witnessing how Gabe learns to accompany the visually impaired and becomes a messenger of light in their lives. Along the way, Gabe undergoes training in obedience, navigation, and danger recognition, while also building a deep bond with his trainers—an emotional connection that warms the heart. As Gabe’s training nears completion, he approaches his graduation ceremony, where he will be paired with his visually impaired partner. From strangers to companions, every encounter and every shared moment redefine the meaning of trust and reliance. The stories of the visually impaired are often heartbreaking; many once felt despair after losing their sight. Yet the arrival of a guide dog allows them to embrace life anew. The cold, unfeeling cane is replaced by warm fur. Each steady step, each patient pause, becomes a testament to regained dreams. With the companionship of a guide dog, they walk forward together in light—witnessing the profound bond between human and dog, and the story of hope that shines through.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師和賽思突然遇到一場暴雨，於是二人出發尋找雨傘。他們發現第一把雨傘出現於三千年前的中國。當時這種傘並不適合擋雨，只能用來遮陰。到了十七世紀的歐洲，他們找到第一把用油布造的傘。雨傘慢慢改良，令它不但變成必需品，甚至是時尚飾物.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師逛公園時遇到正在畫漫畫的小賽思，她的橡皮擦只用剩一小塊！尋古大師提議帶她買一塊新的，並利用這機會回到中世紀，從而發現修士用刮刀來改正錯處。他們繼續前往亞馬遜，二千年前當地土著在這裡發現了乳膠，這物料在幾世紀後，被發現可用來擦除墨水！今時今日，橡皮擦是學童及畫家必備的工具。賽思很享受這次旅程，更為自己的漫畫找到了新靈感.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 溫暖的皮毛和羽毛讓衆多動物寶寶令人想擁入懷中，但這些華麗外衣的功能遠比表面所見更多。亮麗的色彩與鮮艷的斑紋都是大自然的隱身術，讓這些生物能於衆目睽睽之下隱身，或令暗中虎視眈眈的掠食者眼花繚亂。請與我們一起倒數十大最想擁抱、最討人喜歡的得意寶寶.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Long Chai (with mild intellectual disabilities) works daily in a warehouse. For most people, this may seem like a monotonous and tedious job, but in Long Chai's world, everything has its own rhythm and order. With focus and persistence, he leads a fulfilling and organized life each day. Supervisor Tommy is not only Long Chai's boss but also an important partner in his growth, always providing support and encouragement with care and patience. . This time, Long Chai will step out of the familiar warehouse to take on a completely different job—working as a bakery clerk. Throughout this process, Jason will accompany him, not only experiencing Long Chai's daily work routine firsthand but also witnessing how he adapts to a new environment and uncovers previously undiscovered potential. This is not just a job experience; it is an exploration of perseverance, growth, and inclusivity.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 消防及救護教育中心暨博物館
programme.desc: 消防處其中一項重要使命是「教育市民，並提高公眾的消防安全意識」。而消防及救護教育中心暨博物館於2016年隨著消防及救護學院啟用。透過展示過去一些珍貴圖片、制服、裝備和車輛等，讓市民了解消防處150多年的歷史和發展的同時亦能提升個人及社區的消防安全意識.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 真相帶來的傷害
programme.desc: 靳時川向徐來表示，想她做自己的家屬，徐欣然答應。霍岩宗知道靳、徐二人和好，藏起自己借酒消愁。于詩詩碰見醉酒的霍，送他回家但遇見徐來，霍當着徐的面吻了于。在一次聚會中，于詩詩告訴徐來，霍跟她假拍拖的真相，而徐發現靳早知道事情，氣憤下離開，並不理睬他.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集: 道歉大行動
programme.desc: 靳時川在眾隊員的幫助下，以各種方式猛追徐來，徐漸漸被打動。于詩詩出席雲開集團樓盤發佈會，借機威脅霍岩宗繼續假扮情侶。靳發信息給徐，約定下班後在餐廳見面，忽然靳接到緊急任務出動。徐致電找不到靳，急忙往事故現場，以為他凶多吉少，最後靳出現了.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 消防及救護教育中心暨博物館

programme.title: 「亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026」國際賽
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 承接上集《港樂．講樂》Pop Up Show在葵芳新都會廣場開騷，黃博、李佳兩位靚聲女王繼續與民同樂，除擔任隊長，率領歌迷大玩遊戲外，黃博將為大家帶來劇集歌《來日方長》，李佳亦獻上重新編曲的經典廣東歌《追憶》，讓現場樂迷聽出耳油。. 主持. 林泳怡. 歌曲：. 黄博《來日方長》. 李佳《追憶.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 服裝業是香港主要的製造業之一，部份年輕人更加將時裝設計視為夢想職業，將創意化為雲裳，讓模特兒在舞台上展現佳作、一展風華。在實現夢想之前，設計師要將靈感或設計理念轉化為服裝樣辦，踏出投產的第一步。但隨著製造業北移，香港的「辦房」所剩無幾，製作樣本實在不容易！今集我們將走訪製衣業訓練局創樣中心，看看一件時裝樣本如何從一幅設計圖，通過裁縫師傅的巧手而變成一件靚衫.

programme.title: 命懸一生
programme.desc: 南洋村長透露徐財增之子徐慶利曾涉嫌殺人後自殺，孟朝懷疑其死因欲開棺驗屍，並從麻仔與村長口中得知徐慶利與田寶珍的過往：兩人曾是糖廠戀人，但因徐慶利安於現狀且沉迷享樂，與積極考學的田寶珍漸行漸遠；而此時真正的徐慶利正化名倪向東躲在衛海爛尾樓中複盤謎局.

programme.title: 周末大電影：踏破鐵鞋無覓處
programme.desc: 一小男孩為了要把家課簿還給同窗好友，不惜違背父母的訓示，長途跋涉跑到小山那面的鄰村去訪尋好友.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Dictation has long been part of Hong Kong primary school life, but new curriculum guidelines urge schools to scale it back. Some have already cancelled Chinese and English dictation, noting that high scores don’t always translate into better writing. Instead, they’re turning to reading, games, and AI-assisted learning to boost literacy. This episode explores how teachers see the changes, how parents respond to the “no dictation” revolution, and whether in an age of smartphones and voice input, students risk forgetting how to write by hand.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Long Chai (with mild intellectual disabilities) works daily in a warehouse. For most people, this may seem like a monotonous and tedious job, but in Long Chai's world, everything has its own rhythm and order. With focus and persistence, he leads a fulfilling and organized life each day. Supervisor Tommy is not only Long Chai's boss but also an important partner in his growth, always providing support and encouragement with care and patience. . This time, Long Chai will step out of the familiar warehouse to take on a completely different job—working as a bakery clerk. Throughout this process, Jason will accompany him, not only experiencing Long Chai's daily work routine firsthand but also witnessing how he adapts to a new environment and uncovers previously undiscovered potential. This is not just a job experience; it is an exploration of perseverance, growth, and inclusivity.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.sub-title: 最沉默的婦科病殺手 - 卵巢癌
programme.desc: 「卵巢癌」是本港女性十大常見癌症中排第六位。卵巢位於盆腔深處，患病初期難以發覺，不像其他婦科病會有疼痛或陰道異常出血等明顯症狀，容易被忽視而延誤治療，七成患者確診即晚期，所以卵巢癌也被稱為「沉默的殺手」。今集請來婦產科醫生為大家詳細解釋這個病的成因、治療方法，以及拆解種種迷思，實行打破沉默：「問多啲、知多啲」，總有辦法醫治。. 主持：黃秉康醫生、梁凱寧. 嘉賓：翁嘉琦醫生(香港中文大學醫學院婦產科學系名譽臨床助理教授).

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集: 齊丹醫生與中國醫療隊道別
programme.desc: 齊丹醫生即將離開桑納，他特別想到麥樂村看一看，江大喬表示歡迎。齊丹將手裡的病人都交給中國醫療隊負責，江大喬讓他儘管放心。江瑤母親懷上了現任丈夫的孩子，與母親言語間江瑤覺得自己是個外人。柳曉弦想要和馬嘉離婚，馬嘉急得趕緊向江大喬申請回國探親.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 服裝業是香港主要的製造業之一，部份年輕人更加將時裝設計視為夢想職業，將創意化為雲裳，讓模特兒在舞台上展現佳作、一展風華。在實現夢想之前，設計師要將靈感或設計理念轉化為服裝樣辦，踏出投產的第一步。但隨著製造業北移，香港的「辦房」所剩無幾，製作樣本實在不容易！今集我們將走訪製衣業訓練局創樣中心，看看一件時裝樣本如何從一幅設計圖，通過裁縫師傅的巧手而變成一件靚衫.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 我所看見的颶風
programme.desc: 隨着地球暖化，颶風的猛烈程度不斷上升，而2024年更出現了有紀錄以來最具破壞力的一些颶風。在雲層之上，氣象學家正努力搶先一步，利用尖端科技從空中甚至外太空，去監測這些巨型風暴——包括配備紅外線的無人機、無人飛行器，以及專門為此研發的飛機。. 我們可以看到科學家、氣象專家和美國太空總署（NASA）如何深入美國、加勒比海及世界其他地區的風暴中心，收集能夠挽救生命的關鍵數據.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：秦川被邀偵查清江兩案
programme.desc: 海平追加了兩輪測試，李田終於暴露，基本可以確定他殺害了朱玫玫，他如實招供並帶領警員指認埋屍地點。2016年，秦川再度來到清江複盤案件，眾人向秦川講述了“清江兩案”的歷史，指出當年專案組花費巨大心血調查命案，但八年來都未有突破，一轉眼18年就過去了.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：秦川帶隊回清江查案
programme.desc: 秦川聽完大家訴說清江兩案的經過後，決定退掉回省城的機票，去看案發現場。退休的蔣繼忠專門前來，請求秦川在有生之年破案，眾人動容。因此，秦川決定在全省範圍內開展一次疑難案件攻堅，解決積案冷案問題。秦川帶著劉林等人前往清江，曹忠恕也從緒城出發與眾人匯合.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI建未來》. 香港地小人多，要將巨型組件安全送到工地，每一步都是考驗。港大團隊以AI物流系統，配合區塊鏈與物聯網，為每個組件規劃最穩妥的路徑。這不只是一項技術突破，而是一班科學家用心解決香港獨有的難題——突破香港獨有的空間限制，為建造業開創新路.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 唐代建築篇 (英文版)
programme.desc: The two hosts, having traveled from Hong Kong, will venture beyond Nara to explore Kyoto and Osaka in this episode. . Kyoto, with its ancient charm, is well-known to many in Hong Kong. Since the hosts aim to provide a unique and in-depth experience, the places they visit will be different from the usual tourist spots. They will take viewers away from the hustle and bustle to the outskirts of Kyoto, starting with a visit to a chestnut orchard to pick chestnuts. Next, they'll head to the famous Uji tea area, where they will participate in tea picking and a soba noodle-making experience. . For cultural experiences, they will take part in a sumi ink-making workshop, highlighting the influence of Chinese culture. Interestingly, the works of famous Tang dynasty poets like Li Bai and Du Fu were highly regarded by the Japanese. . Traveling is not just about sightseeing but also about enjoying food and shopping. The hosts will visit a 120-year-old shop that originally specialized in stage makeup products for geishas. They will also discover that the face oil paper we commonly use today was invented by this very company. . As a nation adept at absorbing foreign cultures, Japan has embraced not only Chinese culture but also jazz music, which has a history of over a century in the country. Although the younger generation now shows less enthusiasm for jazz than previous generations, the music-loving hosts will still visit a jazz live house to experience the lingering charm of jazz.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 根據環保署的研究，海洋垃圾與人類活動息息相關，偏遠海灣因水流及地理因素，往往成為垃圾積聚的黑點，發泡膠碎、漁網和膠樽隨處可見。環保署推出「組織海岸清潔活動八部曲」，讓市民可以自行組織清潔活動，並獲得垃圾袋、棉手套等物資支援.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 銅坐龍1965年出土於黑龍江阿城區，為金代文物，身長19.6厘米，重2.1千克，造型融合犬姿、鷹爪、馬鬃等特徵，並以卷草紋裝飾，體現女真民族「淳質尚儉」的審美傳統。坐龍紋人飾專屬帝王鑾駕，見證金朝遷都燕京的歷史。銅坐龍融合漁獵圖騰與中原皇權，反映女真文化與中原禮制的碰撞與交融。它是金源文化的標誌性器物，也是中華文明多元一體格局的生動見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶
programme.desc: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶出土於南海明代深海裏的沉船，屬明正德年間景德鎮民窯精品。瓶身紋飾精妙，集瀝粉、鏤空、貼金、彩繪等工藝於一身，展現明代中期的高超製瓷水準。此瓶是當時為海外市場高端訂製的產品，見證「隆慶開關」政令之後，明代海外貿易蓬勃發展，亦是海上絲綢之路文明交流的重要物證，現藏於中國（海南）南海博物館.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯1970年出土於陝西西安何家村窖藏，屬唐代文物。杯體以罕見瑪瑙製成，呈獸首造型，形似橫放的牛角或平臥的羚羊，嘴部鑲金塞，紋理自然流暢。此杯造型與西亞、地中海的「來通」酒具極度相似，可能為中亞或西亞進貢之物，或由外來工匠於長安製作。它既是唐代宮廷的實用酒器，亦見證絲綢之路上的文明交流，反映唐朝開放包容、融匯多元文化的恢弘氣度.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 一號青銅神樹1986年出土於四川廣漢三星堆遺址，高3.96米，是現存同期體積最大之青銅單件文物。神樹分三層九枝，枝上有花朵、果實及神鳥，似乎隱喻生命繁衍及自然規律的共生；樹旁有龍盤踞，呈現古蜀人「通天達地」的宇宙觀。其造型與《山海經》所載「扶桑神樹」高度脗合，應為祭祀儀式的核心聖物。神樹歷經三千年重現於世，是古蜀文明信仰與藝術智慧的結晶.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 聞名天下的越王勾踐劍在1965年出土於湖北江陵望山一號墓。這把來自春秋晚期的青銅劍，全長不足60厘米，卻在出土時毫無鏽蝕、鋒利如新。其劍身密佈的黑色菱形暗花與劍首十一個僅距0.2毫米的同心圓，展現出先秦匠人登峰造極的鑄造工藝。節目將細訴劍上八個鳥篆銘文如何道出「臥薪嘗膽」的越王勾踐之傳奇，並探究此劍何以流落楚地之謎.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 七孔骨笛1987年出土於河南賈湖遺址，距今約八千餘年，以丹頂鶴尺骨製成，長22.7厘米，七孔，音域橫跨兩個八度，半音階齊全，是至今中國發現最早、保存最完整的吹管樂器。骨笛可演奏五聲調式及西域樂曲，反映新石器時代已具備七聲音階觀念。賈湖人在無金屬工具下，憑反覆度量打磨，精準開孔調音，展現非凡智慧。此笛既是狩獵誘具，亦是祭祀神器，見證中華禮樂文明的曙光.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 《坤輿萬國全圖》繪製於明朝萬曆三十年（1602年），由傳教士利瑪竇與士大夫李之藻合作完成，是中國首幅中文世界地圖。圖中以中國為世界的中央，收錄五大洲、四大洋及天文地理知識的附圖，並融入中西繪圖技法。地圖旁註文豐富，記載各地風物與奇聞，展現明代先人對世界的探索與求知精神。「坤輿」意思為大地，此圖見證中華文明兼容並蓄的胸襟，是東西方文化交流的珍貴見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 翔鷺紋銅鼓1976年出土於廣西貴縣羅泊灣1號墓，鑄造於西漢初年，屬石寨山型銅鼓代表作。鼓面中心為十二芒太陽紋，主暈是銜魚翔鷺紋，鼓胸刻有羽人划船紋，鼓腰畫上羽人舞蹈紋，紋飾生動寫實。此鼓採用合範鑄造工藝，體現西漢時期南方青銅鑄造技術的高度水準。銅鼓是古代南方民族權力與財富的象徵，亦是中華民族多元文化交融的歷史見證.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: Extraordinary Lao Cuisine takes audiences into the rarely seen world of Lao dining in Hong Kong to explore the unique flavors of this Golden Triangle hub. Host Andy Dark personally samples “Luang Prabang” specialties, such as “Sinatal Ki” Chicken, to uncover the secrets of Lao culinary traditions. The episode highlights four-color glutinous rice and introduces the medicinal culinary culture of natural dyeing using sappan wood and pale butterfly bush flowers. . The proprietress also personally demonstrates how to cook "Lap Khao" (Lao crispy fried rice) and teaches the traditional three-finger technique for eating sticky rice by hand, showcasing the rich, layered sensations of Lao cuisine: crispy, sour, spicy, and sweet. The program also documents the restaurant's transition into a street-stall and takeaway operation. Though the dining room lights may dim, the enticing aroma of the food lingers on—allowing the flavors of Laos to permeate the daily fabric of the city and inspiring more people to discover this mysterious cuisine.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥婆婆與胡伯無兒無女，一直只有二人共同生活，相濡以沫。直至大坑西拆遷消息來臨，二人為尋找新居奔波煩腦之際，麥婆婆突然在街上暈倒。. 年近九十歲胡伯獨力尋找新居、搬家，更要照顧跌傷腳後無力自理的麥婆婆，二人漸明白長此下去不是辦法。胡伯找到環境合適的安老院，麥婆婆掙扎苦思半年後，終下定決心到院舍入住。胡伯堅持每天探望，麥婆婆日漸適應院舍生活，同時接受物理治療等院舍服務，安老院亦不時舉辦護老新產品推廣活動，發現軟餐發展亦令老年人生活重拾姿彩。. 二人重新找到生活等節奏。大坑西重建在即，二人重遊勾起半生回憶，對將來亦重燃寄望.

大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Diary of birdwatching at Tai Tong
programme.desc: Tai Lam Country Park is located in the western New Territories, spanning the Tsuen Wan to Tuen Mun area. It is the second largest country park in Hong Kong. There are seven reservoirs at the entrance of the park. Starting from Tsuen Kam Au, you can walk on Sections 9 and 10 of the MacLehose Trail. Along the way, you can admire Tai Lam Chung Reservoir and Ho Pui Reservoir, the largest of them all. After finishing the walk, you can go through Tuen Mun Leave the golden beach. . Come to a bird watching instructor and learn to watch forest birds.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.sub-title: 李展鑾 : 戲劇 / 夢 / 人生
programme.desc: 李展鑾，劇團總監，舞台劇狂熱份子，夢想是一直做喜歡的戲劇，當自己人生的編劇、導演和演員。他由中學時代開始投入戲劇世界，並在大學延續其對戲劇的熱情，無論是擔任主力，或是當製作團隊的小崗位，他均樂在其中。畢業後，為了平衡追夢與生活，他選擇利用工餘時間從事戲劇行業，其後更創立劇團，擔任班主，繼續創作。. 這一集，我們一起走進李展鑾的戲劇世界。面對現實環境的限制、家庭崗位的轉變，他如何堅持初衷？又怎樣走進校園，將夢想結合教育，啟發新一代追尋戲劇夢.

programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖
programme.desc: Aunt Bing complained to Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission, crying and accusing them of mishandling her case, which resulted in the loss of all her assets. Crystal patiently comforted her, but Tony showed little sympathy and tried to dismiss her. The retail company "Good Day" went public with its acquisition of its competitor, "Nikkou House," causing a significant increase in the latter's stock price. However, the investigation team discovered unusual large-scale transactions that occurred before the news was announced. They found Fong Kai Ming for questioning. Fang seemed innocent, but Crystal discovered someone named Hong Tsz Lok in his daily activities, who had financial dealings with him. It turns out that Hong Tsz Lok, a senior business manager at Good Day, borrowed money from Fong Kai Ming and took advantage of the insider information to make a quick profit. Tony sympathized with Hong's situation and felt sorry for him, which puzzled Crystal. She couldn't understand why Tony had such different attitudes towards Aunt Bing as a victim but Hong as a wrongdoer, leading to an argument between them. However, Crystal had no idea that Aunt Bing's reason for complaining to Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission and wanting to recover her money since she had fallen for another online investment scam and even resorted to borrowing from loan sharks, hoping to make up for her previous losses all at once.

programme.title: 香港故事-從獅子山遠眺神州大地
programme.desc: 今集西域之旅會認識昔日車師前國，這古國是昔日吐魯番地區的一個重要大國；交河古城和高昌古城是當今世界上最大、最古老，保存最好的生土建築城市，2014年他們被列入世界文化遺產名冊。西漢時有張騫出使西域，到了東漢時，為何又派班超出使西域呢?漢唐時期，吐魯番都是信奉佛學，為何後來改信伊斯蘭教呢?除了佛教和伊斯蘭教外，拜火教也曾在西域留下不少痕跡。最後，再認識昔日位於中國西北部在黃河中上游的西夏國，亦即是今日寜夏一帶。西夏國國君李元昊，為強大自己國家文化，更參考漢人文字，創造出他們的西夏文字。. 主持：文恩澄. 嘉賓主持：朱銘堅博士(香港大學中文學院助理教授).

programme.title: 悅讀憲法 英文版
programme.sub-title: Living in Harmony — Ethnic Equality Enshrined in the Constitution
programme.desc: The Chinese nation is a diverse and inclusive family, with a rich array of cultures and traditions. How does the Constitution lay the institutional foundation for ethnic autonomy and shared prosperity, and foster collective advancement among all ethnic groups through exchange and mutual learning? Article 4 of the Constitution states that all ethnic groups are equal, and the state shall protect the lawful rights and interests of all ethnic minorities, uphold relations of equality, unity, mutual assistance and harmony, and assist all ethnic areas in accelerating their economic and cultural development. Through a visit to an ethnic minority community in Guizhou Province guided by Professor Li Tianyi of Guizhou Minzu University, this episode offers an immersive experience of traditional cultures and customs of the Miao people and other ethnic groups, and explores practices in ethnic autonomy and cultural preservation, showcasing the vitality and depth of diverse cultures flourishing together under the safeguard of the Constitution.

programme.sub-title: 消防及救護教育中心暨博物館
programme.desc: 消防處其中一項重要使命是「教育市民，並提高公眾的消防安全意識」。而消防及救護教育中心暨博物館於2016年隨著消防及救護學院啟用。透過展示過去一些珍貴圖片、制服、裝備和車輛等，讓市民了解消防處150多年的歷史和發展的同時亦能提升個人及社區的消防安全意識.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇製作特輯-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演製作特輯。. 同學隨參訪團參觀內地及香港與抗戰相關的地點，深入了解到先輩在抗日戰爭中所展現的偉大抗戰精神，並將體會融入短劇演出中，呈現中國共產黨領導的東江縱隊在抗日戰爭中的英勇事跡，表達對國家安全的理解及愛國情懷。節目旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並以深入淺出的方式讓市民明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 看神州
programme.sub-title: 北京嚴打涉旅違法行為 景德瓷業遺存申遺成功
programme.desc: 首都北京每逢節假日都有大批國內外旅客到訪，多處名勝景點卻經常有人違規向旅客招攬生意，當局近期展開嚴厲打擊。市文旅局更定期發布投訴量最多的15間旅行社名單。. 國產大飛機C919早前開始執飛首條國際商業航線，來往北京與蒙古首都烏蘭巴托。內地民航專家李瀚明認為，有重要里程碑意義。. 「千年古城」景德鎮以手工瓷業聞名於世，最近終於獲得國際認可，在第48屆世界遺產大會上，景德鎮手工瓷業遺存成功列入《世界遺產名錄》。. 同樣以一雙巧手製作匠心獨運作品的，還有河北一名微縮場景模型設計師；另外，內蒙古一個沙漠地區推進治沙生態工程，推廣「以工代脤」，讓數以萬計農民收入得以增加.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 服裝業是香港主要的製造業之一，部份年輕人更加將時裝設計視為夢想職業，將創意化為雲裳，讓模特兒在舞台上展現佳作、一展風華。在實現夢想之前，設計師要將靈感或設計理念轉化為服裝樣辦，踏出投產的第一步。但隨著製造業北移，香港的「辦房」所剩無幾，製作樣本實在不容易！今集我們將走訪製衣業訓練局創樣中心，看看一件時裝樣本如何從一幅設計圖，通過裁縫師傅的巧手而變成一件靚衫.

programme.title: 夢想中華人物誌 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Reform Pioneer: Henry Fok Ying Tung
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Henry Fok Ying Tung firmly believed in the principle of “taking from society and giving back to society.” He established foundations and supported the modernization of the nation through donations and non-profit investments, covering areas such as education, healthcare, sports, and the development of Nansha. After his passing, his descendants have continued his beliefs and ideals, carrying forward the “China Dream” he envisioned. . Interviewees include:. Ian Fok Chun Wan and Timothy Fok Tsun Ting (Sons of Henry Fok Ying Tung). Kenneth Fok Kai Kong (Grandson of Henry Fok Ying Tung). Yang Jie (General Manager of Nansha Grand Hotel). Pui Kwan Kay (President of the Football Association of Hong Kong, China).

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 2026 年3月29日，政府飛行服務隊航空啟導國際學院成立。保安局局長鄧炳強在主持成立典禮時表示，隨着香港與粵港澳大灣區深化融合，香港作為航空門戶的策略重要性與日俱增.

programme.title: 中華知識王
programme.sub-title: 第六集 - 擊鼓木頭車竟是古代計程車？｜瀋陽故宮X廣東丹霞山X昆明斗南花市秘聞？｜古代秦始皇事蹟你又知多少？
programme.desc: 卓然老師先亮出「季札掛劍」這個春秋時期的典故，用一把寶劍講述一個關於誠信及友情的故事。然後迎來今集三支強勁參賽隊伍，分別是能歌善舞的「聲動中華隊」、縱橫歷史長河的「龍騰四海隊」及鑽研廣東、廣西和海南一帶地域文化的「嶺南文化社」，到底哪一隊能從專攻中國和香港法律史的吳海傑教授手上取得「中華知識王」？問題覆蓋範圍相當廣闊，由古代秦始皇事蹟、明清科舉考試至近代中國航天發展、國家《憲法》，都會逐一考考參賽隊伍。而第二回合「萬水千山識中華」會帶大家到訪瀋陽故宮、廣東韶關仁化縣的丹霞山、「世界第二大花卉市場」昆明斗南花市，了解當中一些鮮為人知的趣聞。第三回合「中國黑科技」的題目則是一個載有鼓的古代兩輪木車，車上有木人揮臂擊鼓，到底它是甚麼東西？早於一千八百多年的漢朝早有記載這種工程智慧，堪稱為「中國最早的計程車」。兩者之間到底有甚麼關係？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌揚. 嘉賓評判：吳海傑(香港大學法律學院副院長). 參賽隊伍：聲動中華隊、龍騰四海隊、嶺南文化社隊. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作，6月7日星期六晚上8時播出.

programme.title: 橫素全中國
programme.desc: 今集，主持會往西北走，去到一個被認為與天空接近的地方-青海省西寧市，一直以來都是進入青藏高原的第一站，一個集多元文化及宗教色彩之地；當地人傳統上以牛羊肉為主食，當地的素食文化，呈現出獨特的「禪意」和「健康」，取材於高原的食材，青棵、藜麥、酸奶及獨特的.

programme.title: 田耕紀
programme.desc: 孫家派人綁走連蔓兒。孫父表示要她為兒子殉葬。連蔓兒無法勸說服孫父停手，即將葬身火海。.

programme.title: 煮題COOK 6 中山好食好煮
programme.desc: 經過廿多年研究, 內地成功養殖出無毒河魨, 而中山坦洲就是其中一個擁用國家認證的河魨魚源基地, 今集兩位主持難得直闖魚基地, 了解養殖過程, 重點還是享受了一頓”人間美味”。 盛宴由一碗魚湯展開, Jacky 一試真情流露了, 竟然是一生中嚐過最鮮美.

programme.title: 一個人鐵道行 4
programme.desc: 跟著「網紅」雙層列車 Y752 夜發昆明、晨到麗江，把路途變成移動展館：酒吧車廂開到深夜，民族風佈置與現場表演讓旅客先熱身。抵達麗江古城，先拜訪木氏土司在地底蘊，到引水入城的開放格局，一步一個故事。手作環節我們親做東巴紙，再用祭司傳承的東巴文把記憶寫.

programme.title: 橫素全中國
programme.desc: 繼續青海的旅程，探索當地三大必到景點，有故事嘅日月山，中國最大鹹水湖青海湖，與及聞名世界的內陸鹽湖察爾汗鹽湖，感受大自然創造的奇觀，過程中不斷尋素，西寧市的藏式火鍋，品嚐青藏高原特色藏茶湯底及地方蔬食。另外，又會踏上格爾木的旅程，一早到當地市集逛逛，.

programme.title: 一個人鐵道行 4
programme.desc: 大家都說雲南是避暑勝地，但沒想到七月也能看到雪。阿倫搭上最新觀光火車直奔玉龍雪山，銀白山脊，像把夏天切出一道極地口感。再轉入藍月谷，湖水藍得像調色盤打翻在山谷裡，回到古鎮，吃一碗道地的過橋米線。黃昏收場，我們闖入「荒野之國」用回收廢料搭起的遊園地報廢.

programme.title: 五平方Squarefoot 優質樓盤專區特約 : 樓盤傳真
雪板呼嘯—阿勒泰毛皮滑雪紀實
田耕紀
programme.desc: 秀兒作賊心虛，害怕夭折的嬰靈回來找他，接著葉兒和小七都暗示嬰靈就在她身邊，把她嚇得半死。.

programme.title: 煮題COOK 6 中山好食好煮
programme.desc: 中山小欖被譽為菊城，除觀賞外，當地非常流行食用菊花，兩位主持趁著大型菊花盛會，親身去試試各式菊花美食，菊花包、菊花鯪魚球、菊花餅及菊花咖啡，真是大開眼界，還未夠嗎？出外用餐追求整體體驗的Jacky，今次又有好介紹，一間位於3A景點內的園林餐廳，嶺南風.

programme.title: 快閃．泰日韓
programme.desc: 《快閃．泰日韓》第一集由嚴崇天帶隊展開韓國之旅，帶著Wren何天嵐和Ece曾天妤在首爾吃喝玩樂，參觀韓國美妝推廣體驗館，試用各種韓國出品美妝用品，Wren和Ece更即場體驗韓式化妝化身韓妹，之後再到多間人生四格相館大影各種創意有趣主題靚相，笑料百出。.

programme.title: 橫素全中國
programme.desc: 橫素全中國最後一站，當然是香港，主持嘉年的私心素食推介，香港人對素食第一印象，最傳統的百年齋舖；輕食之選的Cafe，還有由米芝蓮大廚主理的素食FineDining， 亦有最貼地的素食車仔麵，也由創意組合的新派素食餐廳，最後，更有健身教練分享素食也可以.

programme.title: 高鐵旅遊呈獻 : 臥底．高鐵團
programme.desc: 「臥底高鐵團」5天貴州團，參觀亞洲第一大黃果樹大瀑布，阿正妹頭置身水簾洞感受瀑布水花嘅威力，讚嘆雨後彩虹嘅奇幻美景。在千戶苗寨突然有位團友送個大”柑”比佢哋，佢哋又會揀咩回禮呢?阿正食團餐食到豬牛不分，即場被大廚取笑，點解會咁失敗呢？今團碰巧凱里苗侗.
